title: philotheca angustifolia subsp. montana
intro: Philotheca angustifolia subsp. montana, commonly known as the Mountain Bush-pea, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family, native to Australia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Philotheca angustifolia subsp. montana include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and coumarins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
